title: Fakeaway Doner Kebab
ingredients: 500g (1lb 2oz) lean minced lamb (the leanest you can find)
2 teaspoons dried oregano, plus extra to serve
2 teaspoons sweet paprika, plus extra to serve
method: Put the meat in a large bowl and use a wooden spoon to mix in the oregano, spices and seasoning. Break up any lumps. Crack the egg in and mix into the spiced meat.
Using your hands, shape the meat into a large sausage, compressing as much as possible, and wrap in foil.
Prepare the slow-cooker by scrunching up 2 pieces of foil to place at the bottom of the pot.
Use a sharp knife to poke a few holes in the underside of the foil to allow fat to escape. Place the kebab on top of the scrunched foil (or cut in half and place side by side to fit).
Place the lid on and cook on low for 5-6 hours. Remove the meat from the foil, scrape away any residue and sprinkle with paprika and oregano. Allow to cool slightly, then slice as finely as you can.
notes: Serve with Super Slaw, Quick Purple Pickle (p.183 & p.210), warm pitta breads and chilli sauce. Leftovers are great chopped up in the Spiced Tomato, Lentil & Chickpea Soup (p.134).
